Ram Air Inlet

An air intake system that uses forward motion of the aircraft to force external air into ducts for ventilation or pressurization.

Questions and answers

What is Ram Air Inlet?

In this glossary, Ram Air Inlet refers to: An air intake system that uses forward motion of the aircraft to force external air into ducts for ventilation or pressurization.

How is Ram Air Inlet used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Ram air inlet obstruction detected, switching to alternate ventilation mode."
